correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the temporal t-column constraint graph D_t for Rule 22, with edge (a,b)->(b,c) iff for every time j the unique-one rule gives b_(j+1). For t=2, recurrent SCC sizes [4,2,1]; for t=4, [18,18,4,2,1]. Two 18-state components are temporal shifts, while the smaller recurrent components are doubled period-two subgraphs; hence 4C4(n)=2tr(A^n). Independently generated all nine simple cycles of one 18-state SCC with length multiplicities 8:1,9:2,10:3,11:2,12:1, all meeting at the four stated vertices. Thus the determinant expansion has only singleton cycle terms: det(I-zA)=1-z^8-2z^9-3z^10-2z^11-z^12. The log determinant proves the exact generating series, and intersecting cycles prove the exact support semigroup {8..12} ∪ {n>=16}, not just finite enumeration. Independent exhaustive binary state iteration for n=3..16 agrees with 4C4 counts, and symbolic 18x18 determinant yields all displayed coefficients. Perron-Frobenius primitivity (lengths 8,9) gives λ^n/2, not a conjectural numerical fit.
